notes.title: Update Alpha 020
notes.content:
In-game changes:
[list]
[*] [b]All game code has been completely changed and optimized.
[*] The errors that have been reported during all this time have been corrected.
[*] Character bust sizes have been adjusted to match their height.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/0dea52e2e989114de89a6538df958e2c4fbe6b29.png[/img]
[*] Special outfits and hairstyles for Nova have been added. (Patreons only)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/a5ac1fc0e610c8f5ab0e89b04726f5c550a2ece2.png[/img]
[*] Aby, Amy, Margott, Venus and Huntress busts have been added. Additionally, other character busts have been improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/bda7c1c2d0a920f04aed73979260c49bc7ecc986.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/73c18542ce93695c3b5ad4c50b62cfcf46129cc7.png[/img]
[*] Busts in combat sequences have been changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/87add21ac0a725284f8f6e8249e4aa10addeed7d.png[/img]
[*] Day 4 has been added in-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/0606cf3819435513c9fe57281434742e64523007.png[/img]
[*] A new section has been added to the Grove map.
[*] All enemies have been visually removed from the maps. Now its appearance is every certain number of steps. (Only enemies that are important or necessary to complete quests have been left visible.)
[*] Hairstyle variations in sequences have been temporarily removed. These will be available with new hairstyles and skins later in development.
[*] Rewards for Patreons in-game have been changed.
[*] “Event Gallery” has been added with all the languages currently available in the game.
[*] “Dream of Drops” have been added to Venus' shop.
[*] A new type of currency called Platinum has been added to spend in the Venus shop.
[*] The save data images in the game at the moment don’t work very well.[/b]
[/list]
Well, I think it is a very good summary of what has been done in general terms. [b]An apology to everyone for this delay in the game, but I think I have had to experience what hell is like in game development.[/b] [i]When programming the 4th day in the game, I realized how bad programming I had done in the game due to my zero knowledge from when I started.
So, if I wanted to add faster updates, I had to correct it before I went further and made it more complicated to correct it. So, I had to redo all the codes which took a lot of time. [b]But it is already corrected and ready for the new thing to come.[/b][/i]
Now my way of working will change completely. [b]Since there are 4 playable days in the game[/b], I will not advance any further. What I'm doing is adding the side quests, enemies and missing sequences between days. [i][b]Since due to lack of time I omitted many of them and now I will integrate them. If I did it right, there will be no problems integrating them month after month.[/b][/i]
I think I was too optimistic in believing I would finish a game in 5 years.
[b]But I think that since its first version the game has evolved and improved. What memories.[/b]
[i][b]I also didn't imagine that I would be able to draw 20 sequences for the game.
The road is long, but I will not give up offering a quality story and game. I hope it ain’t too much text.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Skins Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/84dfe80ff63fac502cc1223708cc89654c6fe398.png[/img]
[b]Skins and Hairstyles for Nova are now available for all Patreons.
These outfits can be unlocked in “The Fashion House” with their respective Patreon ranks.[/b]
[i](Note: The skins are currently only for the Nova busts and don’t apply to the sex scenes.)
(Note: I also recommend reopening your Patreon chests for these changes to take effect.)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/18ac3f80ee97c107fa6dda36a6c6648d7037eb5d.png[/img]
[i]Programming the 4-day events in the game, I ran into a lot of my old code and a lot of mistakes I made as a newbie at the start. And I realized that if I didn't fix them, this would cause problems and delays in future updates. So, I corrected most of these errors and optimized some things.[/i]
[b][list]
[*] I removed many busts of Nova that were not used and made a touch-up on his model as well as that of Princess Roxana. These will be the final ones in the game.
[/list][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/efb8770fb45df911b38698f140623d0b1030a50a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Add the busts of Margott and the twins, Abby and Amy.[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/2a633d2c3a3d12c2544f2eb2b6ac66f533affff8.png[/img]
[b][list]
[*] Adjust the size of Nova, Roxana, Verónica and the twins so that they are proportional to the other characters and the environment feels more immersive.
[*] I had to remove the scenes of Nova with long and short hair, since making a code for these hairstyles would take a long time and in the end my goal is to make all the skins appear. But for now, it will only be the base hairstyle, this will make me focus on just one.
[*] The colors of some busts have been fixed, since some had very dull or lackluster colors.[/list][/b]

[b][i]I made many changes internally and bugs may appear. If that happens, don't hesitate to let me know. I hope you like the new Nova skins.[/i][/b]

notes.title: Update Alpha-010f
notes.content:
Happy year 2022, I hope you are well and I regret the delay in this update, I had planned to do it the first day, but the more I worked on it, the more I realized that it would be impossible.

Now it is a simple update that adds:
[list]
[*] [b]Nova's Succubus suit. (Available after finishing the first night, at the fashion house.)[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/c318d7964754549314f04e99aceceb934039f17a.png[/img]
[*] More than 90 minutes of audio were edited, in a total of 795 lines of dialogue for Nova, Amber, Melinda and Trina. (All the voices that were missing in the previous update.)
[*] Voice was also added to Princess Roxana.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/a8bd51bb28b51d92cdc8607ca12cb6307e6050bd.png[/img]
[*] The audios corresponding to the books were added.
[*] Alessa's rework was done.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/85b47684ccb5a48c89005c4939b7f403115f73a7.png[/img]
[*]And again the Fan Art gallery was added. (I had an error and formatted my pc, several of the Fan Arts that you sent me were lost, so if you can contact me again to place them.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/6096ab9e27f1e3110968806ea396c4c1ee717668.png[/img][/b]
[/list]
[b]The Halloween event was also made, but due to lack of time, it could not be included in the month of the holiday. Sounds, transitions, arrangements and testing in detail are still missing, but the [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/60932065]Patreons[/url] will have an exclusive preview of the event for now.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35729853/b3832cddca8194a17408ae4219bab2500dee9aaf.png[/img]
At the moment I had planned to do a bigger update, but I’m still working on the combat system. Since, as those who have finished the 3rd Night will know, the big monsters must already begin to arrive. In addition to being implementing the object creation system and finishing pending content. [b]And I don't want to do things by halves, since I have a harder time correcting mistakes due to lack of planning.
The work on developing a game never ends.[/b]

I have also been drawing a lot these months and I have improved a lot, if you can [b]take a look at my [url=https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/3865555]Pixiv[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/MMVDeepBride]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.deviantart.com/mmvdeepbride]Deviantart[/url] or [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/DeepBride/posts/]Reddit[/url] page[/b], I will be updating. [i][b]Also, they would help me a lot if they shared it or their likes. (Kof.kof. That way I wouldn't kill myself also promoting the game.)[/b][/i]

[b]Thank you for your attention and I hope to finish the next update soon.[/b]

notes.title: Update: REWORK
notes.content:
[b]Well, first of all, I have to thank the people who keep making this game possible, the Patreons who with their help month by month allow me to continue this story. Also, to all the people who follow the development of the game on Discord and those who have voted and given their positive reviews of the game on the different pages found.[/b]

[i]It's been a year full of productive work, but I think you're wondering. If you've worked all year on the game. Why isn't there new content? Well, the answer is simple, get caught up in the so-called Development Hell. Because of my little experience in all the fields of making a video game. Develop the game on a fragile foundation. And proof of that, are the Bugs that many experienced, where the game closed after a few minutes of running it.[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4fqLJEI.png[/img]
[b]But thanks to the RPG Maker Mv software update to Mz this year[/b], I had the opportunity to correct the mistakes I made in the game. Of course, this was not easy, [b]I take about 500 hours of work on the new software, to this day[/b], I think the work I have done to improve the game is remarkable. And it gives me a stronger foundation to continue building the game in the future.

[b]For that reason, I could not include night 3 and 4[/b], already many will have seen the scenes finished, the work is done, it is only a matter of scripting the events and creating the new maps. But I think I'm going to rest for a couple of weeks before we go on as I've been exhausted and unspired.

[b]Here's a little bit of what I'm missing in this game review:[/b]
[list]
[b][*] The art of twins Aby and Amy needs to be renewed just like the Queen's throne.
[*] Nova's art in combat will be revamped to 2D animation.
[*] Nova's Lingerie Skin is removed and replaced with Baby-doll, which appears for moments in this update.
[*] The Fans' Art Gallery will be added later.
[*] The Event Gallery with enhanced Venus art will be added later.
[*] The game credits have not yet been added, as there have been many that have passed this year, in addition to the credits corresponding to the software, DLCs, music, Plugins. Uff is a huge list.[/b]
[/list]
[b]Now everything has been changed:[/b]
[list]
[b][*] All in-game scenarios were aesthetically improved and playable.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0Fqnd15.png[/img]
[*] Models from Amber, Nova, Liva, Ramtha, Basth, Luna and Queen Elizabeth were redesigned and updated.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vXLmJTJ.png[/img]
[*] Models of Ninva, Adrazellia, Hyusabi, Juliet, Rebecca, Roxana, Spindra, Trina and Veronica were made.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zgOIzmc.png[/img]
[*] Added quest system, which can be turned on and off from the options menu.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3kmMGc4.png[/img]
[*] Added Autosave system, which must be activated from the options menu or start menu for it to work. (Note: Don’t consume Amulets the autosave, only save the game each time we change map or location.)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wl5rnLz.png[/img]
[*] Custom images were added to the save files, which allow you to get a better idea of how much they have progressed within the story or that they need.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FwRfRuV.png[/img]
[*] The difficulty of the game is balanced, now it is easier to win the fights.
[*] 778 new voice lines have been added, including Amber, Nova, Maya, Trina and Ninva.
[*] Texts have been adjusted to the screen in a more aesthetic way.
[*] The colors within the game have become more vivid.
[*] Momentarily Amulets can be purchased with Dana at the market.[/b]
[/list]
[b]Ufff, basically the game was rework from 0.[/b] This is the version of the game that must have come out, but I think by rushing things and wanting to meet unreal deadlines, I didn't give him the time and affection he deserved. I think that spoiling you learn, which translated would be: The experience that I have gained throughout the development of the game.

[b]Well, here I say good-bye for this month, I hope everyone is healthy and living in their homes with their families.

Have a great new year.[/b]
